design: Exploratory, source-pinned corpus audit plus purposive literature comparison; not an exhaustive systematic review or empirical test of physics
freeze_boundary: Written after initial source discovery and before corpus measurement and comparative coding. Not blinded or externally preregistered.
target: Determine what can be supported about the sheer complexity of EFMW relative to selected physical frameworks, without treating document volume, ambition or incompleteness as theoretical merit.
comparison_set: Noncommutative spectral-action Standard Model plus gravity
EFMW canonical corpus and frozen review snapshot
selection_rule: Purposive coverage of established classical/quantum baselines, alternative quantum ontologies, continuum/discrete quantum-gravity programs and broad unification proposals. Select one stated variant for each family; compare scope explicitly. No inference to all published ontologies.
dimensions: Independent constants, free functions and solution choices
Closure for a specified prediction task
corpus_metrics: Number and uniqueness of canonical entry IDs
Formula UTF-8 byte and lexical-token distributions
Conservative occurrence counts for specified mathematical marker families
Frozen review coverage categories, reported as encodings rather than physical validation
negative_control: Two algebraically equivalent exponential-memory/Maxwell kernels represented by distinct strings; compare raw representation metrics and numerically verify response equivalence. Show that string complexity is representation-dependent.
forbidden_inferences: No equation-count ranking across differently scoped theories
No ontology-count estimate from variable names
No parameter count from all symbols
No treating unreported counts as zero
No physical validation from Lean coverage, code size or simulations
No complexity class or Kolmogorov complexity inferred from text compression

outcomes.global_rank: UNRESOLVED unless a complete inventory, common representation, common scope and invariant metric are supplied
outcomes.corpus_results: DEMONSTRATED only for the exact pinned files and specified extraction rules
outcomes.literature_profiles: SOURCE-SUPPORTED DESCRIPTIVE COMPARISON; single analyst, no inter-rater reliability

stopping_rule: Complete one supported profile for each of the 16 named entries, execute the corpus metrics and equivalence control, disclose missing information and exclusions, preserve all results. Do not add comparators to obtain a favorable rank.
